automated.summary: A scheduled run now receives a capability catalog built from the person-filtered capability set and carried on its existing spawn-input field. Catalog entries gain plural invocation descriptors, one per binding, each rendering its real calling mechanism: the dispatcher for local CLI, the MCP proxy with a server name for patterns, a direct tool name for tool rules and builtin adapters, and an informational entry where an adapter names no callable tool. Overflow sheds in a fixed order and never hides a grant; when even the compact list will not fit, the spawn aborts and publishes a diagnostic. The superseded runtime-context block is deleted and the dispatcher description points at the catalog. Enforcement is untouched.
